{
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "crew_professionalism_attentiveness",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.75,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "A key service driver for satisfaction; well distributed. Readings largely align (attentive crew=high in row 1), though row 4's 'friendly employees' being labeled 'low' is questionable since the complaint was about the reservation system, not crew."
    },
    {
      "name": "service_personalization",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.7,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Distinct axis capturing personalized vs rushed service. Row 2's lack of attention reasonably maps to impersonal_rushed. Somewhat correlated with crew column but adds nuance; some borderline calls on silent rows."
    },
    {
      "name": "customer_support_quality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.8,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Off-plane support is a genuine driver distinct from onboard crew. Row 4 slow_unresponsive matches the reservation/call ordeal well. Well grounded overall."
    },
    {
      "name": "seat_physical_comfort_and_space",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Directly relevant driver, overlaps somewhat with original Seat Comfort but adds a space dimension. Appropriately uses NULL for silent rows (rows 3-5) and cramped for row 2."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_and_beverage_quality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.65,
      "source_groundedness": 0.85,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Largely redundant with original 'Food & Beverages' column, lowering leverage, but text-derived detail adds some value. Well grounded, with correct NULLs where food unmentioned."
    },
    {
      "name": "cabin_atmosphere_quality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Overlaps heavily with seat comfort/crew signals. Groundedness weaker: rows 3-5 (ground/reservation complaints with no cabin description) are confidently labeled poor/adequate as apparent overall-sentiment proxies rather than actual cabin-atmosphere evidence."
    },
    {
      "name": "onboard_product_amenities",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.65,
      "source_groundedness": 0.55,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Reasonable axis, but values appear to track general sentiment rather than amenities. Rows 3-5 describe no onboard amenities yet are confidently labeled 'absent', which the silent text does not support."
    },
    {
      "name": "operational_punctuality_reliability",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.85,
      "source_groundedness": 0.8,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Strong, distinct driver. Row 1 on_time, row 5 major_delays/cancellations correctly read. Row 3 mixed (landed on time but rescheduled) labeled on_time is defensible if narrow."
    },
    {
      "name": "ground_and_airport_service_quality",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.8,
      "source_groundedness": 0.8,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Useful separate axis. Row 1 efficient, row 3/4 chaotic_poor are sound readings. Appropriately Unknown for row 2. Well grounded."
    },
    {
      "name": "aircraft_cleanliness_and_maintenance",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
      "source_groundedness": 0.65,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Plausible driver but rarely evidenced; correctly NULL in many rows. However rows 2,3,5 labeled 'standard' despite no cleanliness mention appear to be default-fill rather than grounded readings."
    },
    {
      "name": "pricing_and_value_perception",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.7,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Overlaps with original 'Value For Money' but text nuance adds some value. Groundedness weak on silent rows: rows 3-5 labeled 'fair_adequate' with no price discussion, a confident specific the text does not support."
    },
    {
      "name": "seat_class_expectation_consistency",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.75,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Interesting driver (downgrade surprises). Row 3 unknown_mismatch (worse seats than paid) and row 5 downgrade_surprise (aircraft swap) are reasonable readings."
    },
    {
      "name": "traveler_type_segment",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.55,
      "source_groundedness": 0.4,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Useful grouping axis but largely redundant with original 'Type of Traveller'. Groundedness poor: rows 1,3,5 labeled 'Family' and row 2 'Solo' with no textual support for family/solo status—appears invented."
    },
    {
      "name": "route_distance_and_flight_duration",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.7,
      "source_groundedness": 0.5,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Derivable from Route and a reasonable modeling axis. But several labels contradict geography: Phuket-Singapore is short-haul (row 4 ok), yet Singapore-Tokyo as 'medium_haul' and KL-HK via SIN as 'short_haul_shuttle' are questionable, indicating inconsistent inference."
    },
    {
      "name": "communication_clarity_and_information",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
      "source_groundedness": 0.7,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Distinct driver relevant to delay/rebooking experiences. Rows 3-5 unclear_or_late align with rescheduling notifications. Row 1 clear_and_timely defensible though communication wasn't the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "policy_enforcement_consistency",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.7,
      "source_groundedness": 0.6,
      "hallucination_observed": true,
      "rationale": "Reasonable axis for rigid/arbitrary handling. Rows 3-5 arbitrary_or_rigid supported by rebooking/seat-reallocation grievances. But rows 1-2 labeled 'consistent_fair' with no policy content read like sentiment defaults."
    }
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
  "source_groundedness": 0.68,
  "rationale": "The added columns decompose satisfaction into a rich set of distinct service drivers (crew, ground service, punctuality, communication, seat-class consistency, support quality) that give genuine grouping/modeling leverage for the query—well beyond the original numeric ratings, though a few (food, value, traveler type) partly duplicate existing columns. Groundedness is moderate: many columns correctly emit Unknown/NULL for silent rows, but several columns (cabin_atmosphere, onboard_amenities, cleanliness, pricing, traveler_type, route_distance) show confident specific values on rows where the source text is silent or contradicts them—apparent sentiment defaults or invented facts—dragging the overall groundedness down."
}
